contents: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data.
Neural networks are computing systems inspired by biological neural networks in the brain.
Deep learning uses multiple layers of neural networks to progressively extract features.
Natural language processing is a field focused on the interaction between computers and human language.
Computer vision is a field of AI that trains computers to interpret and understand visual information.
Reinforcement learning is a type of machine learning where agents learn by interacting with an environment.
Transfer learning allows a model trained on one task to be fine-tuned for a different but related task.
Generative adversarial networks consist of a generator and discriminator competing against each other.
Transformer architectures use self-attention mechanisms to process sequential data in parallel.
Retrieval augmented generation combines search with language models for more factual responses.
Stable diffusion is a latent text-to-image diffusion model capable of generating photo-realistic images.
Large language models are trained on massive text corpora to predict and generate human-like text.
Federated learning trains models across decentralized devices while keeping data on each device.
Quantization reduces model size by representing weights with fewer bits without significant accuracy loss.
GPU scheduling algorithms like MPS and Tally manage how multiple applications share GPU resources.
